name: Phrase counting: 16 bars
lesson:
## Feel the 16, confirm the 8

Hot cue A1 on the first beat of every 16-bar phrase (bars 1, 17, 33, 49) and A2 on the 8-bar midpoint between them (bars 9, 25, 41, 57). Count "one" only on the downbeat; everything else is a number you say quietly.

Most house and techno tracks change something every 16 bars: a new hat, a vocal, the bass dropping out. If your A1 lands where the track changes, your count is right. Two pads instead of one force you to know which phrase you are in, not just that a phrase ended.

tracks.cue: Loop-based tech-house with the spoken 'cameras ready' lines dropping in on 16-bar lines. Count from the first kick: A1 on each 16, A2 on the 8 in between, and check yourself against the vocal entries.
Start at the first kick of the intro. The 'losing it' stab teases in on 8-bar lines and the drop lands on a 16-bar line, so the pads confirm your count.
Long percussive intro across two 16-bar phrases before the 'your mind' vocal. Count it in and hit A1 exactly where the vocal enters.
